explication: Purge is a native Mac cleanup app: it scans for recoverable space, presents safety-labeled results for review, and cleans selected items, usually by moving them to the Trash. The main UI and store are central to that workflow; the store also coordinates scanning and deletion. The README documents substantial branches for caches, developer artifacts, large files, installed apps and leftovers, disk overview, and read-only “Everything else.” Some scanner implementations are unsampled, so their links to the store are shown as unverified rather than asserted as source-confirmed calls.
